text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has come, and it's a time for growing Umamusume to make leaps and bounds in their abilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But for some reason, the camp atmosphere is causing Mejiro Ryan to act strangely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While dealing with these more personal challenges, Ryan also gets a refreshing break after a series of tough races.
